mapper.select: select lr.*, e2.name as approver_name from leave_request lr left join emp e2 on lr.approver_id = e2.id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} order by lr.create_time desc, lr.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into leave_request (emp_id, leave_type, begin_date, end_date, days, reason, status) values (#{empId}, #{leaveType}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, 0)
